current_activity: arrives in the Ardennes and joins VII Corps in First Army
notes: Event date: 22 December 1944 (CMH ETO table for the 75th Division: VII Corps and First Army from 22 December, with the British 21st Army Group attached; the atlas lists the division command post at Ocquier on 22 December; Ardennes p426 on 21 December: "the 75th Infantry Division had just arrived from the United States and would reach the battle zone in a few days"). Event definition: the 75th Division, arrived in France in December and listed under Ninth Army's XVI Corps from 11 December (CMH table), joins Collins' new VII Corps on the western face of the Bulge; this is its first Western Front row. Relationship: VII Corps and First Army (CMH table from 22 December); 12th Army Group assigned; British 21st Army Group attached from 22 December. Location: Ocquier village; atlas date. Coordinates: Wikipedia (fr): Ocquier. Event support: moderate (CMH table, atlas and a Green Book line that dates arrival loosely). Location support: moderate (one list for the post, same day as the table).

current_activity: moves into the First French Army area and relieves 3d Division regiments south of the Colmar Canal
notes: Event date: 31 January 1945 (Riviera to the Rhine ch. 29 p. 550: the 75th Division began moving into the First French Army area on 27 January and by the evening of 31 January was relieving 3d Division regiments south of the Colmar Canal). Event definition: the division joins the XXI Corps in the Colmar Pocket fighting under French operational control; the Green Book gives the area and not a command post. Relationship: XXI Corps unspecified_subordination (from 30 Jan 45 to 10 Feb 45, CMH table); French First Army (Army B until 25 September 1944) operational_control (from 30 Jan 45 to 10 Feb 45, CMH table); Seventh Army assigned (from 30 Jan 45 to 13 Feb 45, CMH table); 6th Army Group assigned (from 25 Jan 45 to 13 Feb 45, CMH table). The table entries start on the first row of the unbroken run (convention V-013). The CMH table has a single corps column and does not say assigned or attached for a corps. The earlier assigned relation to 12th Army Group (CR0297) is closed at 24 January 1945 (inferred_from_next_claim); see the Review note on it. The earlier assigned relation to First Army (CR0298) is closed at 29 January 1945 (inferred_from_next_claim); see the Review note on it. The earlier unspecified_subordination relation to VII Corps (CR0299) is closed at 6 January 1945 (inferred_from_next_claim); see the Review note on it. Location: Colmar, the centre of the sector south of the Colmar Canal. Coordinates: Wikipedia (en): Colmar. Event support: moderate (single Green Book page). Location support: low (the sector is named, not the division position; Colmar is the area centre).
